environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet. The application is exposed directly via an Elastic IP on port 3000. No load balancer or reverse proxy in front. Security group allows inbound TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. The instance has an IAM role with access to S3 and the instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is enabled. No network-level SSRF protections.

config.network: Public subnet, direct exposure on port 3000
config.security_group: Inbound: TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0; Outbound: all traffic allowed
